items.name: Golden Gauntlets
items.description: Brilliant gauntlets that flood the wearer with magical strength. With these on, you can lift even the heaviest of objects.

items.name: Silver Gauntlets
items.description: These wondrous gauntlets impart great magical strength. With these on, you can move heavy objects with ease.

items.name: Goron Tunic
items.description: Wearing this heat-resistant tunic made by the Gorons, you'll be able to tolerate even scorching temperatures.

items.name: Iron Boots
items.description: The weight of these hefty boots makes it impossible to run or swim— but they're excellent for sinking.

items.name: Hover Boots
items.description: With these remarkable boots on, you'll float just off the ground, allowing you to briefly walk on thin air.

items.name: Hero's Clothes
items.description: Made for the Hero of Time, these clothes were bestowed on you with the blessing of Rauru, the Sage of Light.

items.name: Zora Tunic
items.description: Wearing this diving tunic made by the Zora, you can stay underwater as long as you want without coming up for air.

items.name: Goron Bracelet
items.description: Housing the strength of a Goron, this bracelet grants you the ability to pick bomb flowers when worn.

items.name: Fairy-Kid Mask
items.description: A nostalgic mask that reminds you of when you first set out from Kokiri Forest on your adventure.

items.name: Princess Mask
items.description: This nostalgic mask reminds you of when you first met the princess in the Hyrule Castle courtyard.

items.name: Bunny Hood
items.description: This stylish headpiece is extra rabbity. Who can resist those floppy ears?

items.name: Gerudo Mask
items.description: This mask looks just like one of the ladies of the Gerudo. It has a certain striking allure to it.

items.name: Goron Mask
items.description: Just like a Goron, this mask has a big, round face and dark, beady eyes.

items.name: Keaton Mask
items.description: This mask looks like everyone's favorite: Keaton! Wearing one may make you more popular too!

items.name: Skull Mask
items.description: This mask looks like a monster's face— anyone who wears it looks extra tough.

items.name: Spooky Mask
items.description: The woeful expression on this wooden mask is enough to unnerve anyone.

items.name: Mask of Truth
items.description: This mask is a mysterious Sheikah artifact that allows its wearer to hear the secrets of the world.

items.name: Zora Mask
items.description: Look just like a Zora in this angular, striking mask.

items.name: Lenses of Truth
items.description: Magic goggles that reveal the truth, also known as the eyes of truth. These will consume magic power when worn.

items.name: Echo Gem
items.description: Equipping this gem will help you detect nearby Gold Skulltulas through a combination of light and sound.

items.name: Wake-Up Cucco
items.description: This cucco hatched from the weird egg. Its mighty crow is enough to wake even the heaviest of sleepers.

items.name: Fire Arrow
items.description: Magically enchant your arrows with fire (uses 1 magic power). Sets targets ablaze on impact.

items.name: Ice Arrow
items.description: Magically enchant your arrows with ice (uses 1 magic power). Freezes targets on impact.

items.name: Light Arrow
items.description: Magically enchant your arrows with light (uses 1 magic power). Repels evil power with sacred brilliance.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: This wooden arrow can be used with a bow to strike at distant targets.

items.name: Bomb
items.description: Each bomb is packed with explosive powder and will blow away anything nearby when it goes BOOM!

items.name: Biggest Bomb Bag
items.description: Carry up to 40 bombs in this durable sack.

items.name: Bigger Bomb Bag
items.description: Carry up to 30 bombs in this durable sack.

items.name: Bomb Bag
items.description: Carry up to 20 bombs in this durable sack.

items.name: Bombchu
items.description: Once placed on the ground, this wall- climbing bomb zooms off on its own before exploding after a certain distance.

items.name: Boomerang
items.description: A trusty weapon that always returns. You can even use it to collect distant, out-of-reach items.

items.name: Big Poe
items.description: Bound by its lingering attachments, this big poe burns with an undying resentment inside its bottle.

items.name: Blue Fire
items.description: This strange blue flame seems to melt ice that no other fire can thaw.

items.name: Blue Potion
items.description: Drink this potion to fully restore your hearts and magic power. You will be left with an empty bottle after you finish it.

items.name: Bug
items.description: This ordinary, unassuming bug yearns to crawl back into the dark safety of a hole. . .

items.name: Fairy
items.description: When released, this kind fairy will restore some of your hearts. If you get knocked out first, it will also happily revive you.

items.name: Fish
items.description: A small, fresh-caught fish that is native to the waters of Hyrule.

items.name: Green Potion
items.description: Drink this potion to fully restore your magic power. You will be left with an empty bottle after you finish it.

items.name: Half-Full Lon Lon Milk
items.description: Drink this farm-fresh milk to recover a few of your hearts. You will be left with an empty bottle after you finish it.

items.name: Bottle
items.description: You found this bottle at the bottom of Lake Hylia—and there's something inside! Where could it have come from?

items.name: Lon Lon Milk
items.description: Drink this farm-fresh milk to recover a few of your hearts. A full bottle has two servings, so you can save some for later!

items.name: Empty Bottle
items.description: You can use an empty bottle to hold all kinds of things. It'd be a waste not to collect something inside!

items.name: Poe
items.description: Bound by its lingering attachments, this poe flickers with an undying sorrow inside its bottle.

items.name: Red Potion
items.description: Drink this potion to fully restore all your hearts. You will be left with an empty bottle after you finish it.

items.name: Broken Goron Sword
items.description: The master craftsman gave you this broken blade. Biggoron on Death Mountain may be able to fix it.

items.name: Biggest Deku-Seed Bag
items.description: You can carry as many as 50 Deku seeds in this pouch.

items.name: Bigger Deku-Seed Bag
items.description: You can carry as many as 40 Deku seeds in this pouch.

items.name: Deku-Seed Bag
items.description: You can carry as many as 30 Deku seeds in this pouch.

items.name: Biggoron Receipt
items.japanese: ダイゴロン刀ひきかえ券
items.description: This claim check is for a sword that Biggoron is repairing. Masterworks aren't made in a day!

items.name: Cojiro
items.description: The cucco lady gave you this special blue cucco. It seems he rarely crows.

items.name: Deku Nut
items.description: A nut variety that can be found all over Hyrule. When one is split open, it will release a flash that can stun monsters.

items.name: Deku Seed
items.description: This type of tough little seed makes for a great slingshot pellet.

items.name: Deku Stick
items.description: This kind of branch can be set ablaze or used to give your foes a painful whack.

items.name: Din's Fire
items.description: Din's power has been infused into this magic, creating a fiery dome around you when cast (uses 2 magic power).

items.name: Eyeball Frog
items.description: This is key to making the eye drops that soothe ash-inflamed eyes. Get it to the Lakeside Laboratory while it's cold!

items.name: Specialty Eye Drops
items.description: These eye drops are a wonder cure that instantly soothes ash-inflamed eyes. Get them to Biggoron before they spoil!

items.name: Gift of Halved Damage
items.japanese: 大妖精の加護・防御力2倍
items.description: Proof of a Great Fairy's blessing, this gift halves damage taken from foes.

items.name: Gift of Improved Spin
items.japanese: 大妖精の加護・回転斬り
items.description: Proof of a Great Fairy's blessing, this gift makes your spin attack emit a mighty wave of magic power.

items.name: Gift of Doubled Magic
items.japanese: 大妖精の加護・魔力2倍
items.description: Proof of a Great Fairy's blessing, this gift doubles your pool of magic power.

items.name: Farore's Wind
items.description: Farore's power has been infused into this magic, creating a warp point when cast in a dungeon (uses 2 magic power).

items.name: Megaton Hammer
items.description: So heavy it takes both hands to swing, this massive hammer grants whoever holds it unparalleled smashing power!

items.name: Hookshot
items.description: Long hidden within the Kakariko Village graveyard, this contraption lets the user latch on and zip to distant targets.

items.name: Longshot
items.description: Enhancements to this upgraded version of the Hookshot enable it to latch on to targets that are much farther away.

items.name: Magic Beans
items.description: Magical beans that can be planted in fresh soil. Leave them to grow for long enough, and the result may prove useful.

items.name: Fire Medallion
items.description: This medallion is a symbol of Darunia's vow to vanquish the Demon King, imbued with his resolve as sage.

items.name: Forest Medallion
items.description: This medallion is a symbol of Saria's vow to vanquish the Demon King, imbued with her resolve as sage.

items.name: Light Medallion
items.description: This medallion is a symbol of Rauru's vow to vanquish the Demon King, imbued with his resolve as sage.

items.name: Shadow Medallion
items.description: This medallion is a symbol of Impa's vow to vanquish the Demon King, imbued with her resolve as sage.

items.name: Spirit Medallion
items.description: This medallion is a symbol of Nabooru's vow to vanquish the Demon King, imbued with her resolve as sage.

items.name: Water Medallion
items.description: This medallion is a symbol of Ruto's vow to vanquish the Demon King, imbued with her resolve as sage.

items.name: Nayru's Love
items.description: Nayru's power has been infused into this magic, granting temporary invulnerability when cast (uses 4 magic power).

items.name: Biggest Deku-Nut Bag
items.description: This woven pouch is big enough to hold up to 40 Deku nuts.

items.name: Bigger Deku-Nut Bag
items.description: This woven pouch is big enough to hold up to 30 Deku nuts.

items.name: Deku-Nut Bag
items.description: This woven pouch is big enough to hold up to 20 Deku nuts.

items.name: Fairy Ocarina
items.description: A gift from your friend Saria, this ocarina is a treasured keepsake. Its gentle tone lends itself to soothing melodies.

items.name: Ocarina of Time
items.description: A treasure of the royal family of Hyrule, this instrument's tone is imbued with a mysterious, otherworldly power.

items.name: Odd Mushroom
items.description: Rush this Lost Woods mushroom to Granny in Kakariko Village. Hurry—while it's still fresh!

items.name: Odd Poultice
items.description: Granny in Kakariko Village made this medicine for you to take back to the Lost Woods!

items.name: Poacher's Saw
items.description: The master craftsman's son left this old saw behind. Despite its age, it seems to be well cared for.

items.name: Pocket Cucco
items.description: Hatched from the pocket egg, this cucco easily fits in the palm of your hand.

items.name: Pocket Egg
items.description: The cucco lady gave you this special egg. It's like a normal egg but much smaller.

items.name: Prescription
items.description: This is a prescription for eye drops that soothe ash-inflamed eyes. Take it to King Zora to get it filled.

items.name: Biggest Quiver
items.description: Store as many as 50 arrows in this quiver.

items.name: Bigger Quiver
items.description: Store as many as 40 arrows in this quiver.

items.name: Quiver
items.description: Store as many as 30 arrows in this quiver.

items.name: Golden Scale
items.description: With this brilliant golden Zora scale, you can dive to great depths.

items.name: Silver Scale
items.description: With this shimmering Zora scale, you can dive deeper than you could before, and you don't even need to equip it!

items.name: Business Scrub Seed
items.description: An odd type of seed that smells strongly of business and can be used to summon Business Scrubs.

items.name: Biggest Deku-Stick Bag
items.description: This handy pouch is big enough to hold up to 30 Deku sticks.

items.name: Bigger Deku-Stick Bag
items.description: This handy pouch is big enough to hold up to 20 Deku sticks.

items.name: Deku-Stick Bag
items.description: This handy pouch is big enough to hold up to 10 Deku sticks.

items.name: Goron Ruby
items.description: This is the Spiritual Stone of Fire, ancestral gem of the Goron people, entrusted to you by Darunia.

items.name: Kokiri Emerald
items.description: This is the Spiritual Stone of the Forest, the gem entrusted to you by the Great Deku Tree.

items.name: Zora Sapphire
items.description: This is the Spiritual Stone of Water, ancestral gem of the Zora people, entrusted to you by Ruto.

items.name: Gerudo Pass
items.description: Possession of this allows the holder to enter the Gerudo Fortress and access the Gerudo Proving Grounds.

items.name: Token
items.description: This token serves as proof of a Gold Skulltula you've defeated. What will happen if you collect more?

items.name: Giant's Wallet
items.description: This enormous wallet is able to hold up to 1,000 rupees.

items.name: Adult's Wallet
items.description: This big wallet, made for grown-ups, is able to hold up to 500 rupees.

items.name: Kokiri Wallet
items.description: Used by the Kokiri, this small wallet can hold a maximum of 200 rupees.

items.name: Weird Egg
items.description: Malon gave you this egg. You can feel something moving around inside. . .

items.name: Zelda's Letter
items.description: Zelda gave you this letter when you visited her at Hyrule Castle. It even has her signature on it—neat!

items.name: Kokiri Tunic
items.description: A comfortable green garment worn by everyone living in Kokiri Forest.

items.name: Piece of Heart
items.description: By collecting this kind of partial Heart Container, you can earn yourself more hearts—one for every four pieces.

items.name: amiibo
items.description: Summon handy items for your adventure. You can change your settings in Options.

items.name: Bow + Fire Arrow
items.description: Loose a fire arrow using the Fairy Bow (uses 1 magic power), and whatever you strike will be set ablaze.

items.name: Bow + Ice Arrow
items.description: Loose an ice arrow using the Fairy Bow (uses 1 magic power), and whatever you strike will be frozen solid.

items.name: Bow + Light Arrow
items.description: Loose a light arrow using the Fairy Bow (uses 1 magic power), and sacred light will dispel any evil power you strike.

items.name: Fairy Bow
items.description: You can use this weapon to attack distant targets, but it takes adult strength to draw and fire arrows.

items.name: Fairy Slingshot
items.description: The stretchy sling on this child- sized toy is perfect for launching Deku seeds at distant targets.

items.name: Deku Shield
items.description: Made of lightweight wood, this shield is the perfect size for a child to use, but it will burn up if it gets lit on fire.

items.name: Hylian Shield
items.description: A mainstay for adult Hylian soldiers, this shield is sturdy, but it's a little heavy for a child.

items.name: Mirror Shield
items.description: Use this shield's pristine mirrored surface to reflect and redirect beams of light.

items.name: Biggoron Sword
items.description: This large sword is both sharp and sturdy. While it is equipped, you cannot use a shield.

items.name: Broken Giant's Knife
items.description: This giant's knife has been broken, losing much of its length and cutting edge.

items.name: Giant's Knife
items.description: It's big and sharp, but this blade breaks easily. It takes two hands to wield, so you can't use a shield with it.

items.name: Kokiri Sword
items.description: This small, child-sized sword is a treasure of Kokiri Forest.

items.name: Master Sword
items.description: Wielded only by the Hero of Time, the Blade of Evil's Bane has the power to transcend time in order to smite evil.

npcs.name: Carpet-Riding Merchant
npcs.japanese: じゅうたん乗りの商人

npcs.name: Poe Collector
npcs.japanese: ゴーストショップ店員

npcs.name: Bombchu Bowling Alley Attendant
npcs.japanese: ボムチュウボウリング屋

enemies.name: Iron Knuckles
enemies.japanese: 二体のアイアンナック
